# Claims intake procedure (test document)

Written for the P1 rule 12 test. Fictional.

The Claims department runs first notice of loss. A Claims Intake Representative receives the
report by phone and records it in the Claims System. The representative checks the policy is in
force, then creates a claim record with the loss date, the claimant and the vehicle.

If the claimant reports an injury, the representative refers the file to the Accident Benefits
team, and an Accident Benefits Adjuster contacts the claimant within two business days.
